subcategory_text: Hold the people responsible for security accountable for fulfilling their responsibilities.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-3, PS-4, CA-1
implementation_examples: Include security objectives in performance reviews for responsible roles
Tie security metrics into team-level scorecards
Perform periodic audits of role-responsibility fulfilment
assessment_objectives: Determine whether responsible individuals are held accountable for security outcomes.
Determine whether accountability is enforced via documented processes.
